Class CarPark

  • java.lang.Object
    • CarPark

  • public class CarPark
extends java.lang.Object
    This CarPark class is used to showcase the location, capacity, current occupation and the availalbe spaces left on the carpark. Cars will be able to park and leave the car park, but only if there is sufficent capacity. The capacity of the carpark can be both increased or decreased, but only if the capacity isnt below 0 or the current occupancy. Any errors with the management, such as lack of available spaces or capacity will be warned to the user. The information about available spaces can be printed out to the user at any time.

    • Method Detail

      • changeCapacity

        public void changeCapacity(int newCapacity)
        Create new capacity variable which contains the added variable (newCapacity) with the original capacity. This allows user to change the capacity of the car park, by adding current value with new value (from parameter). If occupancy is above 0 and the capacity is lower than the occupancy, remove added value from "newCapacity" variable from "capacity" variable. Print out error message indicating that capacity cannot be lower than occupancy and that the original number is restored. If the capacity is below zero, set capacity to 0. So there isn't negative capacity. Print out error message indicating user that the car park is closed.

      • leave

        public void leave()
        If a user leaves the car park, reduce occupancy variable by 1 if it is above 0. Decreasing the occupation, therefore increasing capacity. Else print an error message when the car park is empty (there is no occupation), saying that the occupancy cannot be reduced.

      • park

        public void park()
        If the capacity is the same or more than the occupation, give error message that car park is full. Else the capacity is greater than the occupancy, add 1(a new car enters the car park to occupy a space).

      • printDetails

        public void printDetails()
        Create new capacity variable to store the available spaces left on the car park. Current capacity (capacity variable) minus the spaces occupied (occupancy variable). If the capacity is equal to 1, print out "(location) car park has (capacity = 1) space". Else print out "(location) car park has (capacity greater than 1, or 0) spaces".
